findings.claim: Preserved all 48 test names and count; each method that invokes the tool failed its own assertion against the kit's absent stand-in (75 failures including subTests), then the migrated module passed 48 tests.

envelope.note:
reused: testkit.world, testkit.run, testkit.fakes
World owns HOME, the XDG roots and TMPDIR; every subprocess goes through run with a timeout; gh rate/raw fakes use world.tools.plant. Kit gap: the fake spec answers by argv match, not call order, and delay= does not write the owned marker, so plant_gh_sequence and plant_gh_sleep stay world.tools.plant(script=). Kit gap: Result has no pid, so spawn_named, dead_pid and the loop child are Popen registered with world.own. instrument.py and laneconf.py ride beside the staged tool (HANDOFF-2026-09-13-wall-migration.md). Refusals keep the family's assert_refusal so the assertions stay the same. No regression rows were added because this was a behavior-preserving migration. Same 48 names.
